senses.gloss: a tool or machine used for making holes

definition_translations.zh_TW: 用來鑽孔的工具或機器
definition_translations.ja_JP: 穴を開けるための道具や機械
definition_translations.ko_KR: 구멍을 뚫는 데 쓰는 도구나 기계
definition_translations.vi_VN: dụng cụ hoặc máy dùng để tạo lỗ
definition_translations.th_TH: เครื่องมือหรือเครื่องจักรที่ใช้เจาะรู

senses.gloss: to make a hole using a drill
senses.example: The technician drilled a small hole in the metal plate.

example_translations.zh_TW: 技術人員在金屬板上鑽了一個小孔。
example_translations.ja_JP: 技術者は金属板に小さな穴を開けた。
example_translations.vi_VN: Kỹ thuật viên đã khoan một lỗ nhỏ trên tấm kim loại.
example_translations.th_TH: ช่างเทคนิคเจาะรูเล็ก ๆ บนแผ่นโลหะ

definition_translations.th_TH: เจาะรูด้วยสว่าน

senses.gloss: repeated practice of a skill or procedure
senses.example: The safety drill helped staff respond quickly during the emergency.

translations.th_TH: การฝึกซ้อม

example_translations.zh_TW: 安全演練幫助員工在緊急情況中迅速應對。
example_translations.ja_JP: 安全訓練のおかげで、職員は緊急時に素早く対応できた。
example_translations.ko_KR: 안전 훈련은 직원들이 비상 상황에서 신속하게 대응하는 데 도움이 되었다.
example_translations.vi_VN: Buổi diễn tập an toàn đã giúp nhân viên phản ứng nhanh trong tình huống khẩn cấp.
example_translations.th_TH: การฝึกซ้อมความปลอดภัยช่วยให้พนักงานตอบสนองได้อย่างรวดเร็วในเหตุฉุกเฉิน

definition_translations.zh_TW: 對技能或程序的反覆練習
definition_translations.ja_JP: 技能や手順の反復練習
definition_translations.vi_VN: việc luyện tập lặp lại một kỹ năng hoặc quy trình
definition_translations.th_TH: การฝึกซ้ำ ๆ ของทักษะหรือขั้นตอน

translations.th_TH: สว่านทั่วไป
